records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and nine months ended September 30, 2021, we generated $169.2 million and $492.1 million in total revenue, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended September 30, 2021 was: cloud subscriptions 19%; software license 5%; maintenance 20%; services 52%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the nine months ended September 30, 2021 was: cloud subscriptions 18%; software license 5%; maintenance 22%; services 51%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: All of these factors potentially create the risk of pricing pressure, fewer customer orders, reduced gross margins, and loss of market share.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2021, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $59.7 million and $145.1 million, respectively.
